name: Flexinja
noteEs: Omen mainer reconocido en altísimo elo. Sus videos combinan gameplay highlights con explicación de decisiones de smoke timing, posicionamiento del controller, y reads que justifican plays no-obvios. Para players que quieren entender el rol de Smokes en profundidad — no solo lineups sino mid-round thinking — es fuente sólida.
noteEn: Recognized Omen main in very high elo. His videos combine gameplay highlights with explanations of smoke timing decisions, controller positioning, and reads that justify non-obvious plays. For players who want to understand the Smokes role in depth — not just lineups but mid-round thinking — he's a solid source.
highlightsEs: Guías de Omen y otros controllers con perspectiva de high elo
Smoke lineups en mapas vigentes con explicación táctica
Gameplay en Radiant/Immortal con commentary editorial
Tier lists y análisis de patches enfocados en controllers
highlightsEn: Omen and controller guides from a high-elo perspective
Smoke lineups on current maps with tactical explanation
Tier lists and patch analysis focused on controllers
